name: Takata Steelblade
summary: At Ghost Walker Post, Takata Steelblade leads the Horde's fight against demonic corruption in Desolace. Keldran sent him from Orgrimmar with Maurin Bonesplitter, and Takata now hunts satyrs allied with the Burning Blade.

sections.title: Sent to Desolace
sections.body: Keldran sent Takata Steelblade from Orgrimmar to Desolace to uncover and purge demonic subversion. Takata works from Ghost Walker Post, an isolated Tauren encampment. From there, he coordinates the fight against Legion-aligned forces in the wastes.

sections.title: Scourge of the Satyrs
sections.body: Maurin Bonesplitter tracks and attacks the Burning Blade cultists. Takata turns his forces against their demonic allies, the satyrs. His strikes have devastated Desolace's corrupted satyrs, aiming to break the cult's local power and stop its taint from spreading.

faq.answer: Takata Steelblade is an orc warrior at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. He directs the fight against demonic forces and satyrs allied with the Burning Blade.
Keldran sent Takata from Orgrimmar to fight the Burning Blade and its demonic allies in Desolace.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Takata and Maurin Bonesplitter?
faq.answer: Keldran sent Takata and Maurin Bonesplitter together. Maurin targets the Burning Blade cultists, while Takata strikes their satyr allies.
Takata hunts the satyrs because they are allied with the Burning Blade. They spread demonic taint and threaten the Horde's foothold in Desolace.

faq.q: Where can Takata Steelblade be found?
faq.answer: Takata Steelblade is at Ghost Walker Post, a Horde camp in north-central Desolace.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can find Takata coordinating its defense from Ghost Walker Post. He fights demonic infiltrators in Desolace.
As an orc, you can see Takata carrying out orders from Orgrimmor's leadership to root out demonic servitude.
As a warrior, you can see Takata rely on decisive force to strike down demonic infiltrators.
